conflicts.fact: Decomposing a heptagon from one vertex gives 5 triangles (n-2), but Lesson 1's 'Learned' claims the plot can be split by diagonals while the Lesson 4 Observe says 'four diagonals' and Lesson 7 uses a different decomposition. More importantly, Lesson 7 says its plot has a single diagonal labelled and uses composite standard shapes rather than the 5 triangles.
conflicts.versions: Lessons 1, 4, 6: heptagon = 5 triangles by 4 diagonals from one vertex. Lesson 7: decompose into standard shapes (triangles, rectangles, trapezoids) with 'all side lengths and one diagonal labelled'.
